generator_metadata.summary: A zero-background grid contains a source local frame marked by colors 2 (origin), 3 (+u), and 4 (+v), and a target frame marked analogously by 5, 6, and 7. Three or four cyan (8) source points lie within local radius 3. The output preserves the input and stamps into the target frame every cyan point whose source-local u coordinate is maximal. Coordinates are transferred frame-relatively, and every tie on the maximum-u tier is copied.

review_brief:
# Review — c2f4b540f2fb

Built the missing four-setting native parametric family around the exact canonical default. The family varies local axis (`u`/`v`) and selected extreme (`max`/`min`), uses matched inputs across settings, supports 2–6 demonstrations and four sequentially hidden queries, and includes real frame rotation, ties, decoys, boundary contact, content spread, and 30×30 stress.

The deep self-review attacked fixed-position/rank rules, copy-all/one-point/global-extreme/source-basis shortcuts, duplicate inputs, forged labels, count/type errors, stale/private export surfaces, and crossed intermediate/nuisance controls. It found one real weakness: the original 30×30 motif made two settings coincide because one point occupied two directed extrema. I replaced that motif and added a regression requiring all four settings to disagree on the shared 30×30 input. I also repaired the inherited task test's non-portable canonical-data path.

Final evidence: 35 task tests passed; the adversarial harness passed 16 episodes and 260 protected-Racket evaluations; native authoring preflight passed 8 jobs/96 Racket evaluations; the source-bound causal counterfactual replayed; and 32 public single-query views plus 48 first-turn invariance checks passed.

Limits: all evidence is finite and reviewer-authored. The target remains unapproved; owner review, fresh qualification/acceptance, and training admission are separate pending gates.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The sorted source-local transfer set [u, v, color] produced by step A. This value is consumed as coordinates, not as absolute grid positions.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the source marker frame encoded by colors 2, 3, and 4; express cyan cells within local Chebyshev radius 3 as source-local coordinates; then retain every point at the minimum local u coordinate.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Locate the target marker frame encoded by colors 5, 6, and 7 and paint every intermediate [u, v, color] point through that target basis into a copy of the input.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B paints exactly the local coordinates emitted by step A. On this qualified case, replacing the minimum-u intermediate with the maximum-u intermediate moves the painted cyan cell and changes the final output under protected Racket.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready native prototype: four semantically distinct settings, exact canonical default, two-demo teaching minimum, protected-Racket authoring preflight, and bounded adversarial/export evidence. Owner approval and acceptance are not claimed.
